transformers.note: Ran under 4.57.6 in practice; the model card's requirement has not been transcribed. Grade it before release.

resources._note: 439 GiB of weights, one replica across eight H100s. The vision tower must live on a card that is nearly free of language weights: its forward on the longest clips peaks at ~42 GiB of activations (measured: ~30 GiB held plus a 12 GiB single piece). Caps of 55 and 40 GiB on card 0 both failed, the second also pushing vision-adjacent layers onto card 1 and overflowing its headroom. 12 GiB admits the tower's own weights and little else, leaving ~67 GiB for activations; the language layers spread over cards 1-7 at 68 GiB caps. int8 would fit four cards but changes numerical precision and comparability.
